text:
marta: Kicking a staggered ramp of model v2.7 to 15% now across regions. Change window open. Can folks watch tail latency + error rate and call stop/go? :wave:

deploy-bot: Starting progressive rollout: v2.7 -> 15% (staggered: us-west, eu, ap-south). Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2.7 · canary ID #c-69012 · logs streaming.

samir: seeing a small p95 uptick in us-west within first 2 mins — +180ms. error rate from 0.12% -> 0.58% (threshold 0.5%). Posting quick query: ```logs.query("service=redwood-infer region=us-west metric=p95,errors|last 5m")```

tyler: thanks. can we pause the next wave to ap-south? also recommend pin eu traffic to v2.6 for stability while we triage.

jess: if errors stay >0.5% for another 3m we should rollback. Agree with pin for eu.

kia: looks like the kv-cache prefill heuristic in v2.7 might be increasing cold-start memory commit which triggers the slower tail — quick mitigation: disable prefill flag for the next waves. small config change: `KV_CACHE_PREFILL=false`

marta: do we have a fast toggle? if kia's patch is safe we can try a 5% test, otherwise we'll stop.

samir: we can flip the flag via config service. projection: flip -> stabilize in ~60s, or rollback if no improvement.

tyler: suggest pause ap-south and drop the next wave to 5% in us-west with prefill=false. If p95 back under +50ms and errors <0.4% -> continue.

marta: decision: HOLD (no-go). pausing ap-south wave and reducing live traffic to 5% in us-west; pin eu to v2.6. If us-west recovers per tyler's thresholds we can resume.

deploy-bot: Applying actions: pause_wave(ap-south), adjust_traffic(us-west=5%), pin_region(eu=v2.6). Action IDs: pause-69012-1, traffic-69012-2, pin-69012-3.

samir: after flag flip (KV_CACHE_PREFILL=false) p95 back down ~+40ms and errors at 0.22% — looks stable at the moment. Monitoring for 3m.

jess: looks promising but keep the hold until 3m window closes. If it holds, we can resume to 15% and re-open change window.

marta: 3m passed — signals green. resume plan: incremental to 10% now, then 15% if still good. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

tyler: +1 but keep eu pinned until midnight PST to be safe.

kia: I'll follow up with a postmortem note on the prefill interaction and add a test in the eval harness.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: us-west -> 10% (action traffic-69012-4). eu remains pinned to v2.6. All automated rollback hooks still active.

marta: thanks team. leaving this thread open for 1h to collect notes. I'll file a release-note addendum about the kv-cache toggle. :memo:
